data: Fully reusable super-heavy launch vehicle in development for Artemis HLS + Mars

Fleet launcher entry backfilled to wire Starship up through /plan's view-in-fleet link (was a hanging external-only row). First flight = IFT-1 (Boca Chica, 2023-04-20); controlled recovery of both stages (splashdowns) began with IFT-4 (2024-06-06) per SpaceX flight history.

Two-stage vehicle built around the methane-burning Raptor engine — Super Heavy first stage (33 Raptors) + Starship second stage (6 Raptors). Designed for full and rapid reuse via tower-catch recovery of both stages, targeting Mars transit timelines + Artemis Human Landing System. First integrated flight test (IFT-1) cleared the pad on 2023-04-20 but lost vehicle control before stage separation; demonstrated controlled recovery of both stages beginning with IFT-4 in June 2024.
